This '''A4 laboratory assistant droid''', a modified [[EV-series supervisor droid/Legends|EV-series supervisor]], was inside the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]' [[Prison/Legends|prison]], the [[Citadel/Legends|Citadel]], in the dungeon along with a few [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|BX-series droid commandos]] where [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Even Piell/Legends|Even Piell]] was being held in<ref name="TC" /> around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].<ref name="SWA-2011" /> [[Gender/Legends|She]] was interrogating the Jedi about [[Nexus Route/Legends|intel]] he knew. When the [[Lannik/Legends|Lannik]] refused to talk, the droid was moving to remove Piell's good [[Eye/Legends|eye]] using its needle, but a team of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] that were sent to [[Battle of Lola Sayu/Legends|rescue]] the Jedi Master, burst in. During the rescue, the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] watched as its fellow droids shot by the [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]]. [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] "[[Rex/Legends|Rex]]" blasted the droid through the head and with a final scream of pain, it toppled to the ground, and its [[Color/Legends|red]] [[Photoreceptor/Legends|photoreceptors]] went out.<ref name="TC" />
